transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

I came in because I just can't stop worrying about... well, everything at once. It's like my mind won't shut off. I'm constantly stressing over my marriage, wondering if I'm slipping up at work, worrying about bills, the house projects I keep starting and dropping... I just feel like I'm basically failing as a husband and a father, and the worrying is just getting to be too much.
How long has this constant worrying been going on?

It's been going on for about nine months now. That's when the big cloud migration project at work really ramped up, and, well, that's also around the time the arguments at home started becoming a regular thing.
Before the work project and marital problems began, did you already have a similar pattern of excessive worry?

No, not really. I mean... I'd get stressed out sometimes about normal things, but it was never like this. I used to be able to just, you know, relax at the end of the day and let things go. This constant feeling where I just can't turn my brain off... that really only started around nine months ago.
Have you been feeling persistently down or depressed during these past nine months?

No, I wouldn't say I've felt depressed, really. I mean, I'm definitely exhausted and stressed out all the time, but I don't feel sad or down in the dumps. It's more just this constant anxiety and feeling overwhelmed by everything I have to do.
When you are not dealing with the work or marital problems, do you still experience the same level of excessive worry?

I'm not really sure. It's hard to say because... well, it feels like I'm never really away from those things. Even if I'm just trying to watch a show or take a break, my brain is still spinning about the server migrations or the latest argument. So I haven't really noticed if I worry about other stuff the same way, just because those two things are always taking up all my headspace right now.
On days when the work and marital problems are relatively quiet, do you still find yourself worrying excessively about other areas of your life?

Honestly, there aren't really any quiet days lately. But... I don't think so? Or at least, I haven't really noticed. Like I mentioned, the server issues and the stuff with my wife just take up all my energy right now. I'm not really sure if I'd be worrying about other areas of my life if those were gone, just because those two things are always front and center.
Apart from work and marital problems, do you also worry excessively about other areas of your life, such as your health, finances, or family?

No, not really. Um, like I was just saying, it's pretty much entirely the job and my wife. I don't really find myself stressing over my health or my bank account, or... family stuff. It's just that the work and marriage issues are so massive right now, they take up all the room in my head. I really haven't noticed myself worrying about anything else.
